title: Jagged Robustness: Uneven Safety Transfer and Emerging Vulnerabilities under LLM Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2611.27424v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantization enables efficient inference in language models through model parameter compression. This work audits the impact of quantization on capability and safety domains including model safeguards, instruction-following, ethics and bias. Through benchmarks, we find that model safeguards and bias can degrade under quantization, while other capabilities such as truthfulness remain more stable in Qwen3-4B. We define this uneven transfer of LLM capabilities under quantization as Jagged Robustness. We find multiple factors driving Jagged Robustness: task complexity, evaluation method and generation coherence. Moreover, we verify the degradation of model safeguards by observing increased compliance with unsafe requests under quantization, and demonstrate universal adversarial suffix attacks that are benign for the full model but jailbreak quantized models. translated_title: 参差不齐的鲁棒性：LLM量化下的安全能力迁移不均衡与新出现的漏洞
translated_abstract: 量化技术通过模型参数压缩使语言模型能够高效推理。本工作审计了量化对能力和安全领域的影响，包括模型安全防护、指令遵循、伦理和偏见。通过基准测试，我们发现模型安全防护和偏见在量化下可能发生退化，而在Qwen3-4B模型中，其他能力（如真实性）则保持相对稳定。我们将LLM能力在量化下这种不均衡的迁移现象定义为“参差不齐的鲁棒性”。我们发现了驱动这一现象的多个因素：任务复杂度、评估方法和生成连贯性。此外，我们通过观察到量化后模型对不安全请求的服从度增加，验证了模型安全防护的退化，并演示了通用对抗性后缀攻击——这些攻击对完整模型是良性的，但却能越狱量化后的模型。研究结果表明，假设性能和鲁棒性
tldr: 量化会导致大语言模型的安全防护和偏见控制能力不均衡地退化，而其他能力保持稳定，且对完整模型无害的对抗性后缀攻击竟能越狱量化后的模型。
en_tdlr: Quantization causes uneven degradation of LLM safety safeguards and bias controls while other capabilities remain stable, with adversarial suffix attacks that are benign for full models successfully jailbreaking quantized models.
